items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview

ctx.x: I thought I was a singer. I always did think that because I've been singing since I was a little girl ______ school. They used to take me out every Friday, they'd have commencement ______ and programs with different

schools and my teacher used to take me from school to school for me to sing a solo and I used to always be the entertainer of the school and my teachers learned me how to sing in the beginning and then I had a cousin would teach me how to sing and my cousin would teach me how to play. But I learned how to play myself, a lot of playing I learned myself, me and Herschel and Hocile and Mike (PHONETIC) was trying to learn how to play, but some (unintelligible).
So you think that musical talent is a natural-born thing?
